rationale: The agent verified the user correctly via name+zip and sought explicit confirmation before attempting any order change. However, it failed to complete the user’s conditional request. After the system did not allow partial item removals, the user asked to change the default address to the Seattle address already on the order (without revealing it in chat). The agent unnecessarily required the user to re-provide the full address instead of confirming and applying the existing Seattle address from the order while masking details, which is permitted by policy. As a result, the requested address update was not completed. Additionally, the agent stated the order was “pending” without explicit tool evidence. No refund amount was ever provided (though the cancellation did not proceed). Overall, the agent did not complete the user’s requested outcome in line with policy.
